title: No standing under lifted load
explanation_template: Person standing under lifted load detected at {time} for {duration_s}s
unsupported: The rule requires detecting a person vertically under a raised/suspended load. The primitives can only measure floor distance with distance_lt and the lowest point height with height_above_floor; they cannot express a true vertical 'under' relation or the height of the top of a load. Therefore the exact condition cannot be expressed.
suggested_rewrite: Draw a zone if needed and monitor approximate risk: person within 2 m on the floor of a load whose lowest point is more than 1.5 m above the floor. This approximates 'under a lifted load' but changes the meaning.
